name: rosetta-strip-whitespace-from-a-string-top-and-tail
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

let subject = "   \t some padded text \t  "

write_line("original: [{subject}]")
write_line("leading:  [{subject.trim_start()}]")
write_line("trailing: [{subject.trim_end()}]")
write_line("both:     [{subject.trim()}]")

use IO.Std.write_line
